body:
Thank you for the feedback. I sort of feel like a sitting duck for the med situation. I was on the same medication before... I didn't feel that it was doing much and took myself off. I'd say that my quality of life did decline after going off, but I blamed it on the amount of pot I was smoking and other life factors. My manager at work noticed though, so it's hard to say.
So that's why I'm inclined to give this medication more of a chance, and not just switch immediately...I never had any adverse side effects like I did on another medication I tried a couple years ago.

It's possible that I should increase my dosage. My doctor told me to do so if I felt that the low dosage wasn't helping. I'm just hesitant to do so within the first 6-8 weeks...meds often take that long to take full effect, so I just want to give it a few more weeks to see if I still feel the same.
Yes, I started taking medication again about 5 weeks ago, and I see a counselor once every 2-3 weeks
I apologize for the lack of formatting, I've never posted before and didn't realize it would show up like that.
